lines.text: The people scatter across the wilderness to gather stubble for straw, and the Israelite foremen are beaten.
The foremen appeal to Pharaoh, who calls them slackers, and then tell Moses and Aaron, "May the LORD bless you."

wrong_details.true: look on you and judge you

lines.text: Moses asks the LORD why He brought trouble on the people, and the LORD says Pharaoh will drive them out.
